title: Tyler Benches 41.7 Points and Hands Peyton the Game
dek: Peyton comes back from 19% to beat Tyler, Kyle upsets Sagar, Tony is alone in first at 7–3, and a 4–6 Clark is still the league's top-rated team.

sections.head: The lead
body: Tyler left **41.7 points** on his bench, the 5th most in league history, and lost to Peyton by 21.3. That is the whole story, really: Team Ricci had the points to win and kept them on the sideline.

It didn't look that way early. Peyton was down to a 19% win chance at Sun 1:07pm before Nico Collins' 12-yd TD catch and Parker Washington's 2-yd TD catch swung the matchup 23% each. Uncle Nasty Fingers finished at 145.6 to Tyler's 124.3, Peyton now leads the all-time series 11–10, and his playoff odds went from 7% to 18%. Tyler's slipped from 84% to 78%. The replays are on the site for anyone who wants to relive the lineup decision.

sections.head: Around the league
body: Prithvi posted the week's top score, 167.4, over Clark's 137.8. Jahmyr Gibbs' touchdown swung that one 30%, and Ambiance and Decor jumped three spots to second in the power rankings. Clark got a 44.3-point week from Christian McCaffrey, the 7th biggest single-player week in league history, and lost anyway.

Kyle pulled the upset of the week, 125.8–112.0 over Sagar, who still leads that series 15–7. Sagar's odds fell from 62% to 52%. Stephen beat Evan 140.9–109.3 behind a Cam Skattebo touchdown worth a 26% swing, and Tony beat Greg 133.7–104.3. Greg scored the week's lowest total, 104.3.

sections.head: Power shifts
body: Tony is alone in first at 7–3 and averaging 137.6 a game, ahead of the season record of 133.9 set by Stephen in 2024. Clark (133.4) and Tyler (131.3) are within range of it too.

The ratings still love Clark: **+5.1**, first in the league, at 4–6. He is the unluckiest manager here (scored like a 6.1-win team) and the most scored-upon, with 1331.1 against. Stephen is the mirror image: 6–4, scored like a 3.9-win team, rated −0.4.

sections.head: The playoff picture
body: Four spots. Tony is at 94%, Clark at 83% despite the record, Tyler at 78%, then the scramble: Sagar at 52%, Prithvi at 43% (up from 35%), Stephen at 25% (up from 15%), Peyton at 18% and Kyle at 8%. Greg and Evan are at 0%.

sections.head: Game of the Week
body: Stephen vs Prithvi, two 6–4 teams, with a 61% playoff swing riding on it. Lightning and Thunder is projected 119.1–111.6 and has a 61% chance, with Ja'Marr Chase projected for 21.0 against Patrick Mahomes at 21.4. Stephen leads the series 6–2.
Also worth watching: Peyton hosts Kyle at 74% in a 5–5 bubble game (Peyton leads that series 10–9), and Clark is projected to beat Tony 121.0–117.2. Clark leads that series 11–9.

groupme: Week 10 issue is up. Tyler left 41.7 points on his bench, 5th most in league history, and lost to Peyton by 21.3 after Peyton was down to 19%. Kyle upset Sagar, Tony is alone in first, and Clark is 4–6, rated No. 1 and still at 83% to make the playoffs. Stephen and Prithvi play for a 61% playoff swing this week.
